"Sorry…we'll leave," Mydei mumbles, burning with shame, and as he goes to leave Phainon follows close behind, stopping to stammer out an apology to poor Hyacine, who's fidgeting with the pegasus charm on her hip as she reassures him that it's fine, and that she's glad that everything worked out between them. Mydei can't get out of this titans-damned clinic fast enough though; he's a crimson blur as he rushes past the poor bastard in the waiting room, Little Ica dooting a hasty farewell as he practically sprints out the door, and he doesn't stop until he's near the entrance to the markets, pausing to catch his breath.

Phainon isn't far behind, and when he comes to a stop next to Mydei he lets out a raspy wheeze of a chuckle, hands on his knees as he tries to catch his breath. "Never seen you run so fast before, Mydei. I could barely keep up for once," he says, and Mydei grumbles in response, his body aching with displeasure from the sudden exertion...and the blue balls he's experiencing at the moment.

"Maybe you should take it easy though. Hyacine would never forgive me if you passed out again after she just got you fixed up," Phainon teases, straightening up once he's caught his breath and resting a hand on his cocked hip. He sure is acting oh so casual for someone who was just caught with his tongue down Mydei's throat only moments before. Those words earn him an unimpressed look from Mydei as he straightens up, because really? Now Phainon is worried about him passing out again?

"You certainly didn't seem too concerned about that before Hyacine showed up, HKS," he deadpans, and the way Phainon sputters at that is oh so satisfying.

"It's true that I might've gotten a little carried away, but you started it by kissing me," he says with a huff, though there's not a hint of remorse in his words. Good, because Mydei has absolutely zero remorse about kissing him.

"And you're the one who shoved your tongue in my mouth," he helpfully points out, and Phainon flushes that pretty shade of red again, pouting a little as he looks at Mydei with those damned puppy dog eyes of his.

"Did you not like it?" Phainon asks, and Mydei can't help but find the alpha's need for his approval rather endearing. It's certainly not a common trait among alphas, at least not the ones Mydei has met.

"If I didn't like it I would've bitten your tongue off and spat it back at you," he states with a deadpan expression, leaving Phainon to guess whether he's actually serious or not. Phainon barks a laugh at that, looking both amused and relieved.

"Point taken." Phainon seems pleased with that answer, as graphic as it is, finally glancing around at their surroundings to take in something other than Mydei's impressive body for once.

"Ah…it's a little late to go shopping, unfortunately. All the vendors were closing up when I was heading back to the clinic," Phainon points out, and sure enough, the only stalls open at the moment are those serving alcohol and various handheld snacks, neither of which are things Mydei needs at the moment.

"I only came this way because it was the most familiar route," Mydei admits, crossing his arms over his bare chest, and it's then that he realizes that he'd completely forgotten his armor back at the clinic, leaving him feeling weirdly naked in such a public setting. Walking around with his chest out? Perfectly fine. Walking around with his arms and legs not covered in armor? A step too far, apparently.

Oh well. Something else for future him to deal with. He turns to start back down the route to the bathhouse, Phainon following close on his heels.

"Are you…planning on heading back to the bathhouse then?" Phainon asks, and Mydei once again stops in his tracks, cocking his head at him, because why wouldn't he be?

"Yes. That is where I'm planning to stay during my heat. Why?" he asks, and thankfully the evening crowds at the market are too caught up in drinking and revelry to overhear them. Phainon seems to be fidgeting a little all of a sudden, and Mydei raises an eyebrow at him, a sort of silent spit it out, Deliverer.

A beat, and then Phainon speaks up again, "because…I was thinking that I know a better place for you to stay during it. Somewhere more isolated where the average person can't go."

Mydei blinks, clearly waiting for him to elaborate, even if he knows where this is likely going already. Phainon rubs the back of his neck sheepishly, a faint dusting of pink gracing his cheeks, and Mydei wonders if it's normal to feel cute aggression towards a human.

"Like…my room at the Chrysos Heir villa," Phainon suggests, and Mydei crosses his arms over his chest, expression thoughtful as he considers it. "I said it before, but I want to be there for you during your heat. Not just for companionship, but also to make sure you eat and stay hydrated! I have a kitchen, and I know it's small, but once I stock up on some groceries I can make us some simple meals, and-"

"Fine," Mydei abruptly cuts him off with his answer, the idea of having somewhere secure to stay during his heat with someone he trusts far too appealing to pass up, especially after all the anxiety he's been experiencing lately. He might have protested before, insisted that he didn't need any help, didn't need Phainon spending every waking moment with him when he has far more pressing matters to attend to, but now that he knows that Phainon (probably) isn't going to regret the decision to stay with him during his heat he sees no reason to object. Besides, there's really no going back after you’ve tongue fucked your best friend's mouth, is there?

Phainon clearly wasn't expecting him to give in just like that, likely having planned a whole speech to try and convince him just like he would during one of those inane debates at the Grove, and he blinks at Mydei stupidly, mouth hanging open mid-sentence. It takes a moment for his brain to catch up, but once it does he's practically vibrating with excitement, eyes sparkling like rays of sunlight on the ocean's surface.

"Really? That was a lot easier than I thought it would be," he says with a big, dumb grin that makes Mydei want to shove him against the nearest surface and kiss him stupid again. He'll hold off though, at least for now, not wanting to give the people of Okhema any more reason to gossip, even if he doesn't personally give a damn. He'd just rather not be lectured by Aglaea for getting handsy with the Deliverer in public, thanks.

Mydei huffs, one hand on his hip as he tries to fight back a smile. "Really. But first I need to return to the bathhouse to clean up and gather my things, and perhaps rest for a while. I can meet you at the villa by Lucid Hour tomorrow. That should give you enough time to prepare. But know this," he says, tone shifting to something downright threatening as he steps closer to Phainon and looks him straight in the eye, "there will be no backing out of this. If you're truly serious about spending my heat with me then you had better not disappoint me by getting cold feet, Deliverer." The look of fiery ferocity in Mydei's eyes as he speaks should get the point across, and Phainon's widen for split second before he's mirroring that challenging look with one of his own.

"Since when have I ever went back on my word? You should know I don't back down that easily. Whatever happens, I can handle it. Trust me," he says with all the confidence of someone who truly doesn't know what they're getting themselves into, but that's alright, because Mydei has no idea what's in store for them either. He only wanted to test Phainon's conviction and make sure that this is what he truly wants, and now that he has his answer he can relax a little, at least until he starts to experience those unpleasant physical symptoms again. Thankfully this time he won't be alone.

"Very well. Then this is where we part ways for now," Mydei states, although his inner omega is protesting loudly, because his alpha has already agreed to care for him, so why be apart at all? He ignores it though, and although he knows he really shouldn't he steps closer to Phainon before leaning in to rub his cheek against the alpha's shoulder affectionately, the gesture fleeting yet no less meaningful for it. Phainon looks both surprised and delighted by it, hands twitching with the urge to pull Mydei close and keep him there, but he has to control himself for now, because if they start rubbing all over each other now absolutely nothing will get done.

He settles for a quick nuzzle to the top of Mydei's head, beaming bright as the sun. "Yeah. See you soon, Mydei."

It's a promise. With that they go their separate ways, and if all goes according to plan then maybe, just maybe, this heat won't be the most miserable experience of Mydei's life.

When Mydei arrives back at the bathhouse he's quick to strip down and toss his slick-soaked clothes aside, adding to the growing pile of laundry in his room. He can deal with that later though, because right now all he can think about is scrubbing himself clean, the stickiness on his thighs and ass more than a little uncomfortable now that it's had a chance to cool. He takes a leisurely bath in his private quarters, his mind wandering to what happened between him and Phainon back at Hyacine's clinic. It doesn't seem real, but he can still smell Phainon's lingering scent clinging to his skin (too bad he can't get clean without washing that away as well), feel the ghost of his touch, and as realistic as his dreams can be at times they pale in comparison to the real thing.

So much for keeping my distance.

He'd be lying if he said he wasn't still terrified that things could go wrong between them, that their relationship could sour, or even fracture beyond repair. But as he'd warned Phainon before they parted it's too late to back down now, and Mydei refuses to let himself entertain any thoughts of the regret they may have once all is said and done.

There are still some things they need to discuss before Mydei is completely overcome by pure instinct and hormones, mostly boundaries and such, the most important one being no biting napes and sealing a bond that neither of them can honor when they could die at any point during the Flame-Chase Journey. Taking a mate has never been an option for any of the Chrysos Heirs, no matter how much they may want it. It simply wouldn't be fair to their mate, not when they're destined to die in order to usher in the New Dawn. Of course that doesn't stop Mydei from dreaming about what could be anyway, because he just loves torturing himself, apparently. He's never had any desire to settle down and bear pups (if he even can), but the idea of having a mate by his side both on and off the battlefield, to confide in and find happiness with until the end of their days, is a sweet dream he holds onto regardless of whether it has any chance of coming true or not.

And, of course, there's only ever been one alpha he'd want to share that dream with. He wonders if Phainon has a similar dream, if he's ever allowed himself to even entertain the idea of a mate when the destruction of his hometown, Aedes Elysiae, weighs so heavily on his mind to this very day. Perhaps if he can someday finally free his heart from the shackles of revenge he'll have room in it for something like dreams. Mydei hopes that one day it will be so, but until then he can at least support Phainon in any way he can.

When the bathwater starts to cool Mydei is finally snapped out of his daydreaming, and he gets out of the tub to dry himself off and change into an exact copy of what he'd been wearing earlier, a simple pair of black pants and dark grey underwear, even if wearing the latter feels pointless with how close he is to his heat. The second he's surrounded by Phainon's scent again he's no doubt going to soak right through them, but he might as well at least try to spare his pants a similar fate by wearing them as a barrier. Once he's dressed he gathers up the supplies Hyacine had given him, along with a few spare changes of clothes, setting them by the door before flopping onto his bed to rest for a bit before it's time to leave. Of course his inner omega is demanding that he go right now, but that would defeat the purpose of giving Phainon time to prepare for his stay, so he'll simply have to ignore it for now.

Turns out he's far more exhausted than he'd realized, his body still recovering from overheating, but before he succumbs to sleep he manages to grab his teleslate and shoot Phainon a quick text message telling him to swing by Hyacine's clinic and retrieve his armor and the candies he'd gifted him. Normally he'd just go get them himself, but he'd rather not have to look Hyacine in the eye after all that, so he'll just ask Phainon to do it, since he'd been oh so eager to help. It's an extra trip on top of everything else he has to get done, but it's nothing that the Deliverer of Amphoreus can't handle, surely.

As for Phainon, there's only so much he can do to prepare for Mydei's stay with him when the markets are closed, so when Mydei texts him asking him to grab his armor and the candy from Hyacine's clinic he doesn't hesitate to agree to do so, even if the thought of facing sweet, innocent Hyacine after she'd caught him making out with Mydei is more than a little embarrassing. He texts Hyacine telling her that he's going to be stopping by and receives a few cutesy emojis in response, which Phainon eagerly returns, ever fond of the little chimera emojis he'd downloaded when he'd first bought his teleslate. With that he heads back in the direction of the clinic, and along the way he decides to send a text to Aglaea as well, informing her of he and Mydei's plans, to which she only replies "good luck".

Well. At least she isn't opposed.

Once he arrives at the clinic he's greeted by a much perkier looking Hyacine, who seems to have been able to rest after tending to her last patient, which is a relief. Phainon would feel absolutely awful if she ended up passing out in her own clinic from exhaustion. He informs her of his decision to care for Mydei during his heat, and the way her eyes light up at the news has him wondering if she'd been hoping for this outcome all along. Whatever the case she allows him to grab Mydei's armor and the box of fancy candies from the exam room, and on his way out the door she shoves a thick binder into his arms as well, explaining that it contains everything he might need to know about omega heat cycles. He's a little intimidated by the sheer number of pages inside, but thanks her anyway before heading out of the clinic and in the direction of the Chrysos Heir villa, exhausted from the day's events but no less determined to see this through.

His room is in the same shape he'd left it in when he'd stopped by to change earlier in the day, a little messy but not completely trashed, and he carefully places Mydei's armor in a small trunk at the foot of his bed, his arms more than used to the weight given how heavy his own sword is. He then flops into a chair at his dining table and starts perusing the binder, tired but not quite ready to sleep just yet. As he reads he reaches over to open the box of sweets and snatch a piece of the candy he'd gifted Mydei, figuring the omega will forgive him for it. Probably.

The information in the binder is neatly compiled into sentences he can actually understand, which he appreciates. He never took any clinical courses at the Grove, so his ability to decipher medical jargon is limited, and he doesn't have the energy to go grab a dictionary from the nearest library just to understand the text. However, the more he reads the more the words start to have an unexpected effect on him, namely causing his dick to stir to life, thanks to the ah…rather detailed descriptions of what to expect during an omega's heat cycle.

"At the peak of an omega's heat cycle, typically 24-48 hours from the onset of symptoms, the urgent need to mate will overtake the omega, with slick production increasing substantially. This can cause dehydration within hours if the omega isn't sufficiently hydrated, so any partners present should ensure that the omega drinks plenty of water, even if they must be coaxed into it. It's also important to remember that the omega will continue to present to be mated until they are bred, with the act of being knotted the only way to completely alleviate this need. Alphas should take care to ensure that they're able to stay locked inside of the omega until their knot begins to go down naturally, otherwise medical intervention may be necessary to separate the two."

"Oh," Phainon says aloud to himself, and while he already knew the basics of what occurs during an omega's heat cycle he hadn't considered the fact that the only way to satisfy an omega deep in the throes of heat is to knot them. The idea of knotting Mydei and being locked inside of him is enough to have his cock throbbing in his pants, and his inner alpha wonders how it would feel to have the omega's slick walls squeezing down around his knot and milking every last drop of seed from his-

No. Stop it. I don't have time to be jerking off right now. Besides, from the sounds of things I'm going to need to conserve my energy if I want to keep up with him.

Further reading reveals things like signs to watch out for during an omega's heat that would require medical attention, ideas for simple meals and snacks to make that meet the increased nutritional requirements omegas need to stay healthy during their heat, and a few other things that are common sense to Phainon, but common sense isn't always so common, as a certain professor once told him, so he supposes it makes sense to include them.

The paragraph near the bottom of the page, the last section before it starts talking about contraceptives and pregnancy symptoms and birthing (oh titans above he's going to avoid that section like the plague for now), is the only other one that catches his eye, and when he reads it in its entirely he's left with a racing heart and butterflies in his stomach.

"Omegas will almost always demand a mating bite during their heat, and their partner should take great care not to claim them during this time unless explicitly discussed beforehand. This may cause the omega emotional distress, but a bond is a permanent commitment to a mate, and should not be taken lightly. If the omega should become inconsolable please refer to our guide on the psychology of secondary genders and therapy techniques, now available in most libraries and bookstores."

Phainon stares at that last sentence hard enough to burn holes through the paper. How exactly is that helpful?? What kind of author drops such heavy information only to self-promote their next work?? He doesn't have time to go looking for the next volume, let alone read it in its entirety, and a search on the World Wound Web yields no helpful results. Phainon curses under his breath; he supposes he'll just have to consult Hyacine if things go south, even if he's already asked more than enough of her lately.

Hopefully it won't come to that.

He wishes he knew more omegas, because it would be helpful to get advice from someone who's actually experienced these things firsthand, but Mydei obviously doesn't fall into that category, and Professor Anaxa is…Professor Anaxa. Even if Phainon were to ask him about what it's like to go through a heat (which would be mortifying enough already because he really shouldn't be picturing that) he likely would get some esoteric answer that would leave him even more confused than before he asked. Besides, the very existence of secondary genders is something that the man has gone off on a tangent about more than once, claiming that such things hold humanity back from achieving their true potential, and that he'll figure out a way to eliminate them entirely using alchemy someday. So yeah, not exactly helpful, as much as Phainon respects and admires his former professor.

I guess I'll just have to figure it out on my own.

He only manages to skim the rest of the material before his eyes start growing heavy, and eventually he can't keep them open at all. He supposes a night of rest would be a good idea if he wants to have any energy at all come Entry Hour, so he decides to turn in for the evening, flopping onto his bed without bothering to change out of his street clothes, sleep quickly overtaking him only moments after his head hits the pillow.

He doesn't bother setting an alarm, trusting himself to wake up and head to the markets before Mydei is due to meet him at the villa. He's used to waking up early, his internal alarm clock still set to rising with the sun back in Aedes Elysiae, back when he had chores to tend to around the farm. Nowadays it's much more difficult to tell what time of day it is without looking at a clock due to Kephale's Dawn Device being their only source of light, but thankfully his body still remembers when to rise, even if thinking about the reason why it's programmed that way is painful for him now.

Hours pass as Mydei sleeps off the lingering exhaustion, and when he finally begins to stir he sleepily reaches for his teleslate to check the hour, blinking blearily at the lock screen. It's just turned Entry Hour, it seems, and he contemplates setting an alarm and going back to sleep for a bit, but then he feels that familiar heat simmering just beneath his skin again, and he knows that if he ignores it now he's going to wake up in a similar state to last time, hard and wet and out of his mind with lust. He'd rather die than go out in public like that, so he forces himself to get up and set about gathering his things, checking to make sure he didn't forget anything important. It's a bit early, but surely Phainon won't mind if he arrives a little bit before their scheduled meet-up time, right?

He shoots Phainon a quick text just to be sure, fully expecting the Deliverer to be up and about just like he is every morning.

Mydei: You awake, Deliverer?

Mydei: Waiting any longer isn't an option. If I don't leave now I'm almost certain my heat will start and I'll be stuck here for the duration of it.

He waits for a reply, feeling more than a little anxious until he sees the "read" indicator at the bottom of the messages, and then a few dots appear as Phainon starts typing a response. Amusingly he's listed as "Deliverer" in Mydei's contacts, because of course he is.

Deliverer: I'm awake, yeah. On my way to the markets as I type this!

Deliverer: But feel free to head on over! The door is unlocked! :D

Deliverer: You remember the way, right?

Mydei snorts at that, because how could he forget? He's only visited the villa a million times to see the others, though he and Phainon usually meet up elsewhere, because Aglaea would murder them both if they sparred in the courtyard and ended up breaking the very expensive and beautiful marble decor there.

Mydei: Of course I remember, HKS.

Mydei: And you're a fool for leaving your home open to thieves and assassins.

Deliverer is typing…

Deliverer: LOL I'm not too worried about that considering Aglaea's threads are wrapped around every inch of the place. Plus, Cipher already told me I have nothing worth stealing at my place.

Deliverer: Anyway gotta go, see you there!

Mydei will leave it there for now, ready to be somewhere he can finally relax and let his guard down as his body goes into full-blown heat. With that he's heading out the door and exiting the bathhouse with haste, though the looks he gets as he passes by the early-bird bathers tells him that his scent is back in full force. Something that might've bothered him before, but now he finds himself eager to see Phainon's reaction to it, especially now that his heat is imminent.

I'm going to make sure that he's covered head to toe in my scent before the day is over.

It seems that his brain is already beginning to succumb to his baser instincts, but this time instead of dreading it he embraces it, letting the desire to see the alpha (his alpha) again carry him to Phainon's doorstep. The others seem to be either asleep or busy, because he doesn't run into anyone on the way up to Phainon's room, a large suite on the upper floor of the elegant-looking villa. He glances around the area to ensure that no shadowy figures followed him here (force of habit due to his status), and when he finds none he finally opens the door and steps inside.

Oh. Oh. The place is absolutely covered in Phainon's scent (go figure since he lives here and all), and being surrounded by it has an immediate calming effect on him, which is exactly what he needed at the moment. Of course his hormones kick into high gear at the same time, a wave of arousal hitting him hard and fast, but he tries his best to ignore that part for now, kicking his sandals off and dropping his bag at the door before promptly strolling over to Phainon's bed and face-planting onto it. He's delighted when he finds the bedding completely saturated with the alpha's scent as well, and he buries his face in one of the blankets and breathes in deep, a low rumble building up in his chest as Phainon's scent fills his lungs.

Here. Here is where he'll build his nest, and without even realizing what he's doing he starts to arrange the blankets and pillows to his liking, curling up in the middle of them like a cat when he's satisfied with his handiwork. It could use a few more items, he thinks, and he might raid Phainon's closet later for some clothing items unless the alpha coughs them up first, but for now he lets himself relish the feeling of being completely surrounded by the alpha's scent. He feels more relaxed and comfortable than he has in days, and soon he feels the heavy pull of tiredness overtaking him once again. Warm and secure in his nest he drifts off to sleep once more, the rumbling in his chest persisting even as he slips into the realm of dreams.

Chapter End Notes

So the next chapter is going to be pretty much nothing but pure smut, the juicy pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. Thanks for sticking with the story and I hope you enjoy the rest!

chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Uh. It's like 16k words of porn, so yeah. Enjoy!

Chapter Notes

Once again I got carried away with the chapter length, this one being the biggest yet, which is why it took so long to finish. I spent a few hours editing it so hopefully it's coherent @_@ but anyway I hope you enjoy the porn and feels in this chapter! I decided to split the smut into two parts, with the next one featuring Mydei in heat and Phainon fighting for his life trying to keep them both alive between blowing Mydei's back out lmfao.

Phainon's inner alpha is the source of a lot of his internal dialogue in this chapter.

ETA: I made a few minor edits, mostly with wording and a couple lines of dialogue. Nothing major that changes any of the plot though.

Phainon feels like he's walking on air as he peruses the markets, selecting only the finest fruits and vegetables along with various other ingredients to make into simple meals for when he and Mydei are holed up in his room for the duration of the omega's heat. He's no master chef like Mydei, but he can whip up decent enough meals to keep them fed for a while. The problem will be getting Mydei to eat when he's deep in the throes of his heat, but if worse comes to worse he can force a protein shake down his throat to keep him from passing out from hunger. He always keeps a few on hand for days when he just doesn't feel like making anything or going to a restaurant, though they're not exactly the most delicious things in the world. They'll get the job done though, and that's all that really matters in the end. Phainon refuses to let Mydei's heat be a miserable experience, and keeping him fed and hydrated during it is a huge part of that.

Knowing that he's got the omega he's been pining after for years waiting for him back at his home certainly puts some pep in his step, and he hopes that Mydei is settling in alright. His place is far from extravagant, but the bed is large and comfortable and there's a small kitchen and bathing area for them to use, even if Phainon never bothers to take baths at home these days. Why would he when dragging Mydei to the public baths multiple times a day has become a favorite pastime of his? Of course there won't be any of that happening while Mydei is heat, for obvious reasons, so he's glad that bathing at home is an option. Maybe Mydei will even let him wash his hair this time…the thought of it pleases his inner alpha, because not only would he be caring for his omega that way, he'd also be treated to the sight of a naked, dripping wet Mydei-

No. Stop it. I can't be thinking about that right now. Mydei is counting on me to come back with supplies, and I can't afford to get distracted.

Once he's managed to grab everything they could possibly need (his poor wallet is so empty now) Phainon finally heads back to the Chrysos Heir villa, feeling downright giddy as he makes his way up the stairs to the upper floor where his suite is. The rather hefty bag of groceries blocks his view as he climbs up the steps, and so he doesn't notice the person standing at the top of the stairs until he hears a familiar feminine voice call out to him that's both gentle and solemn all at once.

"Lord Phainon? Do you need help carrying all that up the stairs?"

Phainon hadn't been expecting to run into anyone this early in the day, so when he stops halfway up the steps to peek around the bag of groceries he's surprised to see Castorice standing at the top of the stairs, looking down at him inquisitively. For some reason seeing someone blocking his path right now makes him bristle, because said person is keeping him from seeing his omega, intentionally or not, and his inner alpha is none too pleased about it. He can feel the beginning of a growl stirring in his chest, but thankfully he's still got enough sense about him to realize that he's being absolutely ridiculous right now. Castorice is his friend, and a beta besides, and she poses absolutely no threat to him or Mydei, so why in Kephale's name is he getting territorial right now???

Thankfully Castorice doesn't seem to notice, and Phainon flashes her that warm, sunny smile of his, trying to act casual and like he wasn't just about to growl at her like some kind of wild animal.

"Oh, hey Castorice! You're certainly up early. And no, I've got it, but thanks for offering! I appreciate it," he says in his usual chipper voice, hoping that Castorice won't notice anything amiss. His scent has spiked due to the moment of heightened aggression he'd just felt, but thankfully Castorice has a weaker sense of smell than him, and doesn't seem to have picked up on it. She does, however, look a little surprised to see him carrying such a hefty load of groceries, and of course because Phainon is in a bit of a rush to get back home the universe has decided to stall him in the form of Castorice being a sweetheart.

"That's quite a lot of groceries. Are you doing some meal prepping? If so I can help cut up the vegetables and meat, if you'd like," she says, sounding almost hopeful, and Phainon feels more than a little guilty for wanting to growl at her earlier when all she ever wants to do is help others. He can't have her coming over to his home right now though, not with Mydei there, because he's almost certain the omega wouldn't want her to see him in his current state, and also because Phainon doesn't want her to see him in his current state. Even if she's not an alpha his instincts simply won't allow it, and so he shakes his head, quickly thinking up an excuse to avoid having her enter his home.

"That's kind of you to offer, but I've been feeling a little under the weather lately, and I wouldn't want you to get sick. I'll manage on my own," he says, hoping she'll buy it, because he can already feel his inner alpha getting irritated with this, and he'd rather not snap at her when she's done absolutely nothing wrong. Thankfully Castorice doesn't argue, even if she does look a little disappointed by his answer.

"Oh, I see. Well then please take it easy, Lord Phainon. If you decide you need help later just text me, alright? At the very least I can take the ingredients you bought and prep them at home," she says, and Phainon is relieved that she doesn't ask any unnecessary questions. With that she bids him farewell before continuing down the stairs, and the haste with which Phainon clears the last few steps would put Cipher to shame. Thankfully his door is unlocked still, and once he arrives he wrestles with the groceries in his arms until he can manage to grab the handle and open the door, breathing a sigh of relief once he crosses the threshold.

The relief is short-lived, however, because as soon as he steps inside he's hit with a wall of pure pheromones, omega pheromones, and his body immediately reacts to them with a rush of heat and arousal that nearly has him falling to his knees. Chapter Summary

WARNING some minor characters in here use some language that's highly problematic, and I just want to emphasize that this is FICTION, and I sometimes tackle uncomfortable topics, which may include characters behaving in ways I would never approve of in real life. Just a fair warning!

Chapter Notes

Mydei is, once again, the first one to rise the next day, and when he awakens he feels like he's been hit by a rampaging dromas. In place of the persistent heat that's been simmering just below the surface of his skin lately a bone-deep exhaustion has taken hold, and he feels sluggish and achy all over, like he's just climbed out of the River of Souls. He can't help but wonder if it's because both he and Phainon haven't been on top of hydrating lately. With all the rigorous activity the day before they're both likely incredibly dehydrated, so he should probably make them some more herbal tea to help remedy that. He'll also make them some more fresh honeycakes while he's at it, using the leftover batter and strawberries from the day before. They both need to refuel after all that marathon fucking, even if Mydei isn't feeling particularly hungry at the moment.

He figures that he'll let Phainon rest for a while longer while he makes breakfast, sneaking a peek at his bitten-up shoulders and neck as he pulls on his robe and pulls his hair into a loose ponytail, feeling more than a little pleased with his handiwork.

He looks good with my marks.

Mydei certainly hadn't expected Phainon to want to try being the bottom during his heat, especially since most alphas never want to bottom at all, but Phainon has thankfully never been like most alphas, and they've both discovered some new, fun things about themselves because of it. His back is a little sore, and no doubt Phainon's entire backside is aching after all that, but it was definitely worth it, at least in Mydei's humble opinion.

He hadn't had a chance to clean up after cooking the day before, so he unfortunately has to do the dishes, feeling a little like Phainon's maid at this point. Not that he really minds, especially because he'd been the one to make most of the mess. Plus cooking and cleaning, while being things most Kremnoan warriors left to others to handle, are rather soothing to Mydei, especially when he's doing them for people he cares about. He washes up all the dishes and dries the ones he'll need to use (and wash again later) for the honeycakes before setting about heating some oil in a pan and putting the kettle on for more tea. The act of doing chores does little to ease his physical symptoms, but at least his mind feels clearer now.

…almost a little too clear for being in heat. Even during the moments of clarity in between fuck sessions Mydei always felt that simmering heat beneath his skin, like a beast just lying in wait for the perfect opportunity to strike once more. But right now he feels…strangely cool, almost as if he's gone back to his normal body temperature. There's also a distinct lack of slick between his thighs, and overall he just feels…normal.

Is it over?

Mydei nearly forgets about the oil on the stove until he hears it start to sizzle, signaling that it's ready for the honeycake batter. He grabs it out of the fridge and plops some into the pan, but his thoughts are not on cooking at the moment. He'd gone into this knowing that his heat could last anywhere from a few days to an entire week, but still, it takes him by surprise that he's already back to normal. Well, for the most part, anyway. He still feels tired and achy, but the urgent need to be bred that had been plaguing him during his heat is gone, and he should be absolutely thrilled about that.

So why does the thought of being back to normal make his stomach sink and his chest tighten? The old Mydei had been so utterly terrified of going into heat, of losing control of his own body, but after experiencing it, after being taken care of by his alpha and taking care of him in return, he finds himself almost missing it. Sure, the constant, feverish heat and need to be filled got old quick, but being fucked and knotted and bred had been heaven, with the aftercare being the icing on the cake. Of course he and Phainon can still do those things, and they'll still see each other often enough, but there won't be any more cuddling through the night or waking up next to each other in the morning, nor will there be an excuse for them to ignore the rest of the world and simply indulge in one another for hours on end.

I'll have to leave soon. I need to meet with Krateros and ask him how things are going in the city.

And yet some selfish part of him wants nothing more than to hide away in Phainon's home and pretend that they can stay like this. Mydei doesn't often get the chance to be completely selfish, to put his needs and wants before everyone else's, and if life were fair he'd be able to stay with Phainon and become his mate, having already given his life multiple times for various causes. Hasn't he paid a high enough price to obtain true happiness? Hasn't Phainon paid a high enough price for true happiness? Why must the scales always be tipped on the side of suffering for them simply because of the golden blood flowing through their veins? It's so, so cruel, this existence of theirs, and yet exist they must, for the sake of all of Amphoreus.

We don't get to be selfish.

The distinct scent of something burning finally pulls Mydei out of his misery, and he curses as he turns the heat down on the stove and scrapes the burnt honeycake into the trash. It isn't like him to ruin food (unless he's doing so on purpose to fuck with Phainon), which just goes to show how heavily all of this is weighing on his mind. The kettle is also starting to whistle, and Mydei quickly takes it off the heat before grabbing the mugs they'd used the day before and filling them up with hot water, plopping a tea bag into each one of them. This time the noise seems to have woken Phainon up, the alpha stirring with a groan. It has Mydei glancing back at him, and when Phainon sits up his hair is an absolute mess, giving him an adorably disheveled look that makes Mydei's heart swell with affection.

"Ugh…what's burning?" he asks in a sleepy voice, not yet climbing out of the bed, which makes Mydei wonder if he's feeling sore from the day before or if he's just being lazy. Mydei hadn't exactly been gentle with him, but Phainon hadn't wanted gentle, so if his ass is sore then he only has himself to blame!

"Breakfast. I got distracted and burnt the first honeycake," Mydei admits with a frown, and honestly his own appetite is still practically non-existent, but he'll make more honeycakes anyway, just for Phainon. Because maybe, just maybe, Mydei wants to spoil him a little for once. Not too much though. Can't have him getting used to it.

"I sleep in one morning and you almost burn my kitchen down," Phainon teases jokingly, and Mydei huffs, shooting him an unimpressed look.

"Unlike you I know how to cook on a stove, Deliverer," he retorts, and Phainon pouts a little, crossing his arms over his chest like a petulant child.

"I'll have you know I cooked those meals for us without a single fire breaking out!" he exclaims, and Mydei can't help but chuckle at him, looking amused.

"So you say. I wasn't awake to witness it," he teases, and Phainon huffs at him, a challenging look in his brilliant blue eyes.

"If you don't believe me then I'll just have to demonstrate my amazing cooking skills for you…but not right now. "This will be the first and only time," he says firmly, even if he would absolutely do it again in a heartbeat were he and Phainon to actually live together. But of course that can't happen, so Phainon had better enjoy having Mydei wait on him while it lasts.

"Then I'll be sure to enjoy every second of it!" Phainon says with a big, dumb grin, and Mydei lets out a hmph before going back to cooking them breakfast, making sure to watch the honeycakes carefully this time and not let his mind wander. Soon enough there's a heaping stack of them, and Mydei drenches them with honey and plops a few sliced strawberries on top before digging around in Phainon's cabinets for a tray to serve them on. He finds one that looks, unsurprisingly, like an antique, and he places the plate of honeycakes on it along with Phainon's cup of tea before bringing it over to him and placing it in his lap, cheeks a rosy shade of pink.

But it's their lives in the end, and their choice to make, even if it ends in nothing but pain and tragedy.

But Phainon would rather not dwell on that right now, not when they're both so happy and content. He lays back against the headrest and pats his lap, and Mydei snorts before he crawls over and straddles his lap, a position that certainly has Phainon's cock giving an interested throb, though they should probably behave for the rest of the day to avoid any lingering soreness during their mission tomorrow.

"I'll be sure to show my mark off too then," Phainon says with a fanged grin, and Mydei seems pleased with that, lightly brushing his fingers over the mark on Phainon's neck and making him shiver.

"Good," Mydei says with a fanged grin of his own, and Phainon can hardly wait to strut around like a peacock showing off his mark, even if it's bound to get him in trouble. He busies himself with stroking Mydei's sides and back, enjoying the skin on skin contact with his mate.

Another brief moment of silence passes before Mydei is speaking up again, looking much more serious now.

"If you're still determined to leave for Castrum Kremnos tomorrow then I won't stop you, but I'm not leaving your side either," he says, leaving no room for argument, and Phainon blinks before he's letting out an airy laugh.

"I'd expect nothing less from my mate," he says fondly, the words my mate feeling so new and foreign on his tongue, but he rather likes how they sound together. Mydei flushes slightly, hands sliding down to Phainon's chest to rest over his heart, which is beating slow but steady now.

"Everything may change tomorrow…so as your mate I thought I should let you know that I…" he trails off, flushing deeper, ears and neck turning red in that adorable way that Phainon loves. It seems like Mydei is struggling to get the words out, and Phainon tilts his head like a curious puppy. He stays quiet though, and eventually Mydei manages to say what he wants to say.

"I would bear your pups if I could," he blurts out, looking incredibly flustered as he quickly averts his gaze, and Phainon simply gapes at him, eyes wide and unbelieving.

Did I hear him right?

Mydei…wants to have his pups? To be a parent…with him? 

He bluescreens for a moment as he tries to process this information, and Mydei squirms a little on top of him, letting out a huff.

"Say something, HKS," he mumbles, and finally Phainon is snapped out of his stupor. He grabs Mydei by the shoulders then, looking absolutely shook.

"You…want to start a family with me?" he asks in sheer disbelief, tearing up a little, and finally Mydei looks back at him and gives him a nod, his face as crimson as his tattoos.

He throws his arms around Mydei then with a smile as bright as the sun, suddenly filled with an indescribable joy.

"You don't know how happy I am to hear that…" he says, teary-eyed and sniffling, and Mydei huffs, nuzzling into his neck.

"I just…wanted you to know before I took the pill. Before we set out tomorrow and everything changes," he murmurs, and while it breaks Phainon's heart to know that they can never have a family together at least he knows that Mydei would want that with him, and that knowledge will help carry him through the Flame Chase journey. Imagining little pups running around, some white-haired and some blond, causing mischief wherever they go as he and Mydei chase after them can be a comforting little daydream for him when things seem bleak and hopeless.

"Thank you, Mydei," he whispers, and he can't help but reach between them to rest a hand over Mydei's stomach, wondering if some tiny spark of life has taken hold within him. He shouldn't allow himself to think about that, because it'll only break his heart, but he can't really help it either. Mydei rests a hand over his with a wistful look, and for the first time he can feel Mydei's longing as deeply as his own through their bond.

But he can also feel the love and the joy when they curl up together to go to sleep, the feeling of wholeness, like two puzzle pieces finally slotting together and completing each other. This bond between them can never be broken, not even by death itself, and something deep within Phainon's very being tells him that in every life, in every timeline, he would fall for Mydei, again and again, without regret. Perhaps their lives are destined to end in tragedy, but the journey is what matters, and until he draws his last breath Phainon will hold on to this fleeting happiness.

When morning comes they're forced to untangle from each other and ready themselves for their mission. Aglaea has requested their presence for a meeting with all the Chrysos Heirs at the baths, and Phainon wonders if this will be the last time they all gather together in one place. Losses are a constant on the Flame Chase journey, and there's no telling what tomorrow will bring, so he'll take the opportunity to visit with them all before he heads out to claim Nikador's coreflame.

And he'll head to the meeting with joy in his heart and a skip in his step, because against all odds Mydei's mating bite hadn't healed overnight, and now Phainon can rest easy knowing that his mate forever bears his mark. He and Mydei walk side by side through the markets, their scents inextricably intertwined, and there's no mistaking the bond they now share. It earns them plenty of questioning glances and hushed whispers, but nothing could dampen Phainon's mood right now, not when he finally has the omega he's wanted for ages now as his mate.

When they arrive at the baths and take the elevator up they're greeted by Castorice, Hyacine, Aglaea, and Tribios. Of course it's Aglaea who notices the change in their dynamic first, able to detect their combined scents, and she stares at them as they approach, eyes wide and mouth agape. It takes a moment for the others to notice since they're betas (save for Tribios), and when Hyacine spots the mating bite on Phainon's neck she gasps, slapping a hand over her mouth. Castorice, meanwhile, looks absolutely elated, her eyes sparkling as she looks between the two of them, which catches Phainon a little off guard. Mydei blushes deeply as he averts his gaze from the others, and Phainon lets out a nervous little laugh, rubbing the back of his neck sheepishly.

"Uh…hi?" he says awkwardly, and Tribbie, Trinnon, and Trianne look up at the two of them in awe.

"Snowy…De…you became mates?" Tribbie asks, and Phainon nods, which has Aglaea letting out a weary sigh as she pinches the bridge of her nose.

"I suppose I should've seen this coming…" she says, but surprisingly she doesn't give them a speech about how foolish and reckless they are to become mates as Chrysos Heirs. Instead she crosses her arms and gives them a rare little smile, warm and genuine. 

"I wish you all the happiness in the world," she says, and Phainon and Mydei exchange shocked looks. Perhaps Aglaea had expected this outcome all along. Their desire for one another has never been a secret, after all, even if the two of them had tried to pretend otherwise. Still, it means a lot that Aglaea doesn't think he's a fucking idiot for bonding with Mydei...or at least if she does she doesn't say as much. She seems genuinely happy for them regardless, and that's all that matters to Phainon.

Hyacine is the next to speak up, crossing the distance between them and throwing her arms around both of their middles with a little sob.

"Lord Mydei…Lord Phainon…you…you dummies!!!" she exclaims, looking up at them with wide, tear-filled eyes. Phainon and Mydei both flinch at the insult, but then she's suddenly beaming at them, bright as the sun.

"I'm so happy for you two, even if you're both incredibly reckless!" she says, stepping back and wiping away her tears with a sniffle. Both Mydei and Phainon smile down at her, and Phainon wishes he had time to repay her for everything she's done for them.

"Thank you for everything, Hyacine," Mydei says, voice soft and warm, "give the chubby pegasus some pets for me. And some apples."

Hyacine giggles at that, nodding.

"Will do."

Castorice is next, and she approaches them but keeps a bit of distance between them for obvious reasons. "I'm so glad you two finally got together," she says with a rare little smile, and Mydei and Phainon both flush up to their ears.

"Were we that obvious?" Phainon asks, and the others answer with a resounding "yes" in unison. Mydei looks ready to dive into the River of Souls hearing that, and Phainon might just join him.

"I see. Sorry that I lied to you, Castorice. Mydei...spent his heat with me," he confesses, cheeks ablaze, and Castorice's cheeks turn pink as she looks between the two of them.

"I figured as much. I…hope it went smoothly," she says, and Mydei sputters a little, averting his gaze from her.

"It…was fine," he mutters, and Phainon can't bring himself to look Castorice in the eye as he recalls everything they did together. Titans this is awkward.

"On to the meeting, then," Agalea thankfully chimes in, and all in attendance turn to her, giving her their rapt attention. Thank Kephale. He'd rather not discuss their sex life in front of everyone, especially not with Tribbie, Trinnon, and Trianne present.

"First of all, Phainon, the incident at the markets yesterday has been taken care of…though I cannot say that there won't be any lasting repercussions," she says calmly, and Phainon blinks, because he'd certainly expected far more of a fallout from acting like a wild animal and attacking someone in public.

"Really? What happened?" he asks, curious, and suddenly a familiar singsong voice chimes in from corners unknown.

"I happened," says Cipher, the catgirl seemingly appearing out of thin air, and Phainon's eyes go comically wide as she comes into view. He hasn't seen her in what feels like ages, and her popping up again now feels like some strange twist of fate.

"It was easy peasy to impersonate Caenis and force that scumbag alpha to make a public apology to the Kremnoans. You should've seen the look on his face when I chewed him out while wearing her face!" Cipher says, cackling in wicked delight, and Phainon just stares at her in disbelief.

"But…why would you go out of your way like that?" he asks warily, knowing that Cipher rarely does anything without expecting something in return. Aglaea sighs heavily at the question, shooting Cipher a judgmental look.

"She acted on her own, and now we both owe her a favor, unfortunately," Aglaea says, sounding absolutely Done with her already. Cipher snickers at that, tail swishing behind her as she circles Phainon with a fanged grin.

"Thaaaat's riiiiight~" she says, eyes filled with glee, and oh boy, Phainon can only guess what kind of favor the thief will ask of him once he returns with Nikador's coreflame. "And you can bet I'll come calling when the time is right. Until then…"

In the blink of an eye Cipher appears behind Aglaea, who has absolutely zero reaction to her shenanigans.

"I'll stay here in Okhema and watch how things unfold from here on out. Good luck with your mission, lover boys," she teases, eyes flicking between Mydei and Phainon knowingly. Phainon resembles a tomato as he wonders just how much Cipher knows, how much she's seen, how much she's heard. He really, really hopes that she hasn't been hanging around the Chrysos Heir villa, because there's no way all the moaning and crying out each other's names while blowing each other's backs out would escape her sharp ears. 

"Oh, and congrats on the sex," she adds, cackling her head off as she suddenly disappears into the shadows once more. Well. Phainon has his answer about whether she's been snooping around the villa, at least. Mydei sputters, looking ready to combust on the spot, and Phainon considers diving head-first off the ledge of the baths. Hyacine and Castorice look like they’re fighting back giggles now, but at least Tribios act like they didn't hear anything at all, bless them. 

Aglaea clears her throat then, and now that the distraction has gone they all turn their attention towards her once again. "Now, on to the meeting…"

She briefs them all on the current situation in Okhema, on the most recent attacks by the Black Tide outside the city, and then on the plans for the mission to find Castrum Kremnos. Phainon tries his best to listen attentively, even if the way Castorice keeps looking between him and Mydei like she's waiting for them to make out or something is very distracting. Something tells him that they might just end up inspiring some of those stories she likes to write in her spare time, the ones that she shares on the World Wound Web with everyone. Titans he hopes she at least changes their names if she's going to write steamy fiction about them.

Once all is said and done Mydei and Phainon depart, planning to meet up with Dan Heng and Caelus, who are waiting for them outside Marmoreal Palace. Apparently they'd been unable attend the meeting due to having to deal with a situation regarding Oronyx's power and a pink puppy thing that now follows Caelus everywhere. Phainon and Mydei will just have to fill them in on the details on the way to Castrum Kremnos.

But before they leave the palace Mydei drags Phainon to his personal room at the bathhouse for one last round of scenting and doting on one another before they head out to face innumerable dangers. They may never again have the chance to indulge in such things, regardless of becoming mates. And yet Phainon has no regrets, and he can sense through their bond that Mydei feels the same. For better or worse they are one, from now until the end of their days. 

"No matter what happens out there, I'm glad that I got to experience loving you and becoming your mate," Phainon says softly, his forehead resting against Mydei's as they hold one another, and Mydei's lips curve into a little smile, warm and genuine.

"Me too. I love you, Phainon of Aedes Elysiae," he murmurs, and Phainon engraves those words into his heart to carry with him for the rest of his days, no matter what happens.

"I love you too, Mydeimos."

And the rest, for better or worse, will be left to fate.

Chapter End Notes

Thanks so much for reading! 💕 Comments and kudos are always appreciated! I hope I managed to deliver a satisfying ending! Unfortunately we know where canon goes after this, but we can pretend they get a happy ending, right? :*)

I considered adding a whole Phainon rut crash out arc, but then I decided against it, because I wanted he and Mydei to have a chance to solidify their bond and become mates under (mostly) happy circumstances, lol. I probably could've kept going and written even more chapters, but I think I will now work on a WIP I've had in mind for a while and recently started. It's a vampire AU featuring Phaidei/Myphai and I'm really excited to get the ball rolling on it! I'll likely post oneshots in between chapters as well now that I'm back in the groove of writing fanfic!

If you’d like to read more Phaidei from me please check out my Game of Thrones inspired oneshot that I wrote for Phaidei Week here! You don't need to know anything about GoT to understand it, as it's simply inspired by it and doesn't take place in that world!
